title: Aliens on time travel and wormholes

tellings.quote: They said that um that they have time travel. They don't like to use it very much because um and especially don't like to do long jumps

plain: Steve Colbern, a scientist who studies objects said to be alien implants in human bodies, says the beings he links to a craft over Fillmore, California, told him they have time travel. He tells it as something he heard directly. According to Colbern, they said they don't like to use it much, and they especially avoid long jumps, a hint at how such beings might move through time and through wormholes, which are shortcuts through space.
